channel.title: Troy Meekhof — Articles
channel.description: First-hand, tested, dated articles by Troy Meekhof, The Cybertruck Guy.

item.title: Cybertruck Winter Tire Range Test at 70 MPH
item.description: A controlled 70 mph highway range test comparing the Cybertruck's factory Goodyear all-terrain tires to Tesla's official Goodyear DuraTrac winter tire option, showing an ~8% efficiency penalty.
item.author: troy@grandrapidsmarketingco.com (Troy Meekhof)

item.title: The Cybertruck Guy's Guide to Driving Cybertruck in Extreme Cold Weather (<0°F)
item.description: A practical owner's guide to driving, charging, and preconditioning a Cybertruck in sub-zero temperatures, including real-world range expectations of 150–200 miles.
item.author: troy@grandrapidsmarketingco.com (Troy Meekhof)

item.title: How to Install a Starlink Mini on a Cybertruck Using 48V Power Feeds
item.description: Step-by-step guide to powering a Starlink Mini directly from the Cybertruck's always-on 48V feed and mounting it cleanly with Mars Adventure Gear hardware.
item.author: troy@grandrapidsmarketingco.com (Troy Meekhof)

item.title: The Complete Guide to the Tesla Cybertruck $7,500 EV Tax Credit
item.description: How to qualify for and claim the federal $7,500 EV tax credit on a Tesla Cybertruck, plus referral and military discounts, state incentives, and business credits.
item.author: troy@grandrapidsmarketingco.com (Troy Meekhof)

item.title: Driving Cybertruck from Michigan to Montana - 4,500 miles in 9 days, camping & Overlanding
item.description: A day-by-day account of a 9-day, 4,482-mile Cybertruck road trip from Grand Rapids, Michigan to Glacier National Park, Montana, including camping, off-roading, and Supercharging stats.
item.author: troy@grandrapidsmarketingco.com (Troy Meekhof)

item.title: Cybertruck Rentals in Chicago
item.description: How Troy's Cybertruck ('TARS') was available to rent in Chicago via Turo: logistics, specs, and Chicago-area road-trip ideas. The rental program is now closed.
item.author: troy@grandrapidsmarketingco.com (Troy Meekhof)

item.title: Tesla Cybertruck Rentals in Grand Rapids, Michigan
item.description: How Troy's Cybertruck ('TARS') was available to rent in Grand Rapids, Michigan via Turo: logistics, specs, and West Michigan road-trip ideas. The rental program is now closed.
item.author: troy@grandrapidsmarketingco.com (Troy Meekhof)
